newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas says to modify R-R engines if needed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas says to modify R-R engines if needed.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd would effect any necessary modifications to its Rolls-Royce Plc engines that the manufacturer recommended, a spokesman said on Thursday. Some Rolls-Royce RB211-524 engines in service with other airlines have suffered turbine failures, forcing inflight shutdowns.
But a Qantas spokesman said: "We have had no engine shutdowns as a result (of the engine fault)."
The spokesman declined to comment further but one industry source said a Rolls-Royce representative would visit the airline next week to attend to the issue.
Analysts say such problems with engines arise from time to time and the cost is usually borne by the manufacturer.
The RB211-524 is used mostly on Boeing Co 747s.
